prompt: Look at the picture and choose the statement that best describes it.
promptZh: 請看圖片，選出最符合畫面的敘述。

options.text: A boat has been tied to the upper landing.
options.zh: 有艘船已綁在上方的平台旁。
options.whyZh: 上方是岸邊平台，旁邊沒有船。

options.text: The walkway is blocked by a row of cones.
options.zh: 步道被一排交通錐擋住。
options.whyZh: 步道沒有交通錐，也沒有被擋住。

options.text: The sloping walkway has railings on both sides.
options.zh: 這條斜坡步道的兩側都有欄杆。
options.whyZh: 斜坡步道前、後兩側均畫有扶欄和欄杆立柱。

options.text: A bench has been set next to the lower end of the walkway.
options.zh: 長椅已放在步道下端旁。

explanationZh: 斜坡步道前、後兩側均畫有扶欄和欄杆立柱。
evidence: The sloping walkway has railings on both sides.

vocabulary.note: The sloping walkway has railings on both sides.
